async def act(page):
    # Click on the 'Customers' link in the menubar to navigate to the Customers section
    await page.get_by_role('menubar').get_by_role('link', name='Customers').click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # After clicking Customers, I expect to see a page with options; I need to find and click on 'Orders'
    # Assuming 'Orders' is a link or button in the Customers page
    # I'll use a generic approach to find it by role and name
    await page.get_by_role('link', name='Orders').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now, I need to search for order #301. There might be a search input or filter.
    # I'll look for a search box and enter '301'
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Search').fill('301')
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Search').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # After search, I should see order #301 in a table. I'll click on it to open details.
    # Assuming the order ID is in a cell or link
    await page.get_by_role('cell', name='301').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Now, I need to edit the shipping address. Look for an 'Edit' button or link for address.
    # I'll find the shipping address section and click edit.
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Edit Shipping Address').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Fill in the new address fields. I'll assume standard address fields.
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Street Address').fill('321 Birch Boulevard, Suite 200')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='City').fill('Dallas')
    await page.get_by_role('combobox', name='State/Province').select_option('Texas')
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='ZIP/Postal Code').fill('75201')
    # Save the changes
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Save Address').click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
